tools.name: search_wiki
tools.description: Search the Nightbreak wiki for relevant pages and snippets. Matching is by word and case-insensitive, ranked by title, page name and body. Each result has a `page` value to pass to fetch_wiki_page. Use for high-level docs, examples, and tutorials — not for symbol verification (use search_plugin_sour

tools.name: fetch_wiki_page
tools.description: Fetch and extract readable content from a specific Nightbreak wiki page such as "EliteMobs/lua_getting_started". Page names change as the wiki grows: take them from search_wiki results. A missing page returns `suggestions` with the closest existing pages.

tools.name: get_authoring_notes
tools.description: Where each config type's files go and the plugin rules Forge's own assistant follows: per-type notes, the newer plugins' knowledge, boss movement and combat AI, and the Lua hook quick reference. Read it once before writing files.

tools.name: list_config_types
tools.description: The config file types Forge knows for the released plugins, with each type's plugin, label, server path, format and wiki page. Pass a type to get_config_schema or as the path when validating.

tools.name: get_config_schema
tools.description: One config type's fields as Forge edits and validates them: key, value type, default, whether it is required, description and allowed values. Long option lists are shortened; pass field to get one field with all its options.

tools.name: validate_config_files
tools.description: Validate plugin config files (YAML and Lua) with Forge's validator: required fields, allowed values, plugin rules, Lua analysis, and references between the files you send (a boss's powers, a dungeon's bosses). findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_plugin_source" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the EliteMobs, MagmaCore, BetterStructures, FreeMinecraftModels, CannonRTP and ResurrectionChest source code for a query. By default searches every mirro…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
